Definition: from G575 and ἄγχω (to choke; akin to the base of G43); to strangle oneself off (i.e. to death):--hang himself.
BiblicalUsage: This is the word for Judas hanging himself after he betrayed Jesus. It appears only once, and the Bible does not soften what it describes.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that this single, terrible verse shows where guilt without repentance ends, and why turning back to God matters more than anything.
